full_prompt_en: The image is a square mixed-media collage portrait of a woman's close face assembled from magazine and newspaper fragments. Her face fills almost the entire frame, turned slightly left while her blue-green eyes look upward and to the side. Dark lashes and brows are painted with strong black and brown strokes over small cream paper pieces. Her nose and cheeks are built from overlapping rectangles of beige, peach, pale pink, and warm gray, many carrying tiny printed type and cropped columns of text. Bright red lips form a clean focal accent near the lower center, with small white highlights between them. A broad red and black hat or head covering cuts across the upper right and partly overlaps the forehead. Dark fragments frame the sides of the face, and a small red-orange circular accent sits by the right side. Pale torn paper extends down the left edge and lower corners, leaving a rough border rather than an even background. The collage pieces vary from large flat blocks to tiny sharply cut slivers; some paper edges lift visually through shadows and slight changes in surface height. Brush marks bridge the seams around the eyes, cheek, and mouth, so the expression reads coherently through the fragmentation. Light appears even and frontal, brightening the cream paper and reflective eye highlights, while black scraps and deeper brown patches define the strongest shadows. The viewpoint is extremely close and nearly frontal, with no room or horizon. The composition balances a readable gaze against dense printed texture, torn edges, and energetic red-black diagonals at the top.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形混合媒材拼贴肖像：一张女子近脸由杂志与报纸碎片拼成。她的脸几乎填满全幅，略向左转，蓝绿眼睛向上侧看。深睫毛和眉毛以有力黑棕笔触画在小块奶油色纸片上。鼻与脸颊由米色、桃色、浅粉与暖灰矩形层层搭成，许多纸片带细小印刷字和被裁断的文字栏。亮红嘴唇在下部中央形成干净焦点，其间有细小白亮面。一顶宽大的红黑帽子或头罩切过右上角，部分压住前额。暗纸片框住脸两侧，右边留一处小红橙圆点。浅色撕纸沿左画边与下角伸展，形成粗糙边框，而非均匀背景。拼贴碎片从大平块到极小利落纸屑各有大小；一些纸边因阴影和轻微表面高度变化而像被抬起。笔痕跨过眼、脸颊与嘴周围的接缝，使表情在碎裂中仍完整可读。光均匀而从正面来，照亮奶油纸与眼睛亮点，黑纸屑和较深棕块划出最强阴影。视点极近且几乎正面，没有房间或地平线。构图让可读的目光与密集印刷纹理、撕边及上方充满劲力的红黑斜线相平衡。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media collage layers torn paper, clipped print, small type fragments, and connecting painted strokes into a close fragmented surface. Cream, beige, peach, and pale pink make the broad light field, while black scraps and deep brown marks frame it. Saturated red slices and small blue-green glints provide concentrated focal contrast. Paper pieces range from broad rectangular patches to tiny angled slivers; visible seams, printed columns, and lifted edges retain material depth. Smooth painted bridges keep the broken arrangement coherent without hiding its construction. Even frontal light reveals the paper grain and sharp cut edges, and darker overlapping scraps produce local shadow. The composition is crowded, tactile, and graphic, balancing legible large shapes with a busy mosaic of text and color.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒材拼贴把撕纸、剪裁印刷品、细小文字碎片和连缀其间的绘画笔痕叠成贴近而碎裂的表面。奶油、米、桃与浅粉组成宽阔亮场，黑纸屑和深棕痕把它围住。饱和红色切片与少量蓝绿亮点给出集中的焦点对比。纸片从宽矩形到细小斜屑各有尺度；可见接缝、印刷栏和翘起纸边保留材料纵深。平顺绘画连接段让破碎布局保持完整，又不隐藏其搭建方式。均匀正面光照出纸纹和锋利裁边，叠压的较暗纸屑产生局部阴影。构图拥挤、可触而有图形性，让可读的大形与忙碌的文字色彩镶嵌保持平衡。
theme_en: A woman's close face assembled from magazine and newspaper fragments
theme_zh: 一张由杂志与报纸碎片拼成的女子近脸
name: Derek Gores
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
